title: Chinatown Guided Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children age 0-2 are free but will not receive food unless a ticket is purchased
policies: Substitutions easily offered for vegetarians and pescatarians.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us as we uncover some gems that contribute to Chinatown’s culture and incredible cuisine. We'll taste foods that represent multiple Asian cultures, all from small locally-owned restaurants, and even venture into cultural stores that play a big role in Chinatown. Tasting our way around Chinatown means highlighting multiple communities and countless regional flavors. We’ll cover nearly all corners of the neighborhood while you’re enjoying dumplings, Szechuan, Cantonese, bubble tea, and more. You’re bound to try something new, learn how our Chinatown came to be, and even pick up a new phrase.Not experienced with chopsticks – no problem! This tour can be enjoyed by first-timers, Asian-Americans, and anyone with an appetite for Asian cuisine. Our local tour guide is a Chinese native and can’t wait to share their personal stories, insider tips, and cultural immersion into Philadelphia's amazing Chinatown.
